# Batch B002 — hooks/hook-io.mjs, hooks/stop-co-change.mjs

@@ output/template/.claude/hooks/hook-io.mjs ;; Shared Node.js helper module for hooks (I/O, exit codes, manifest-change state).
@scope executable helper module for hooks
1-3 IM ;; Header: purpose and Node.js 18+ requirement.
4-10 IM ;; Exit-code contract: 0 success, 1 hook error (not blocking except fail-closed PreToolUse guard), 2 PreToolUse block; fail-closed behaviour itself captured at settings.json line 7.
11-14 IM ;; Root-derivation documentation.
16-22 IM ;; Imports.
24-41 IM ;; Reads/validates stdin hook JSON; invalid input exits 1 (visible hook error).
43-48 IM ;; Start-directory derivation from input cwd.
50-59 IM ;; Active repository resolution; failure reports 'Repository checks were NOT run' rather than checking the wrong tree.
61-65 IM ;; fail(): visible hook error, exit 1.
67-71 IM ;; blockTool(): PreToolUse cancellation via exit 2.
73-94 IM ;; respond/postToolContext/postToolBlock/done JSON response helpers (block decision after a tool call makes Claude address the reason).
96-103 IM ;; Repository-relative path helper.
105-116 IM ;; Bounded content identity (SHA-256 or size/mtime > 1 MB).
118-131 IM ;; Documentation of manifest-change state tracking (first snapshot per worktree, Git-status/HEAD diff candidates, removal reporting, state location).
133-140 IM ;; Manifest pathspecs and manifest path predicate (excludes node_modules and .claude).
142-193 IM ;; Computes changed/removed manifests since the last recorded check using git status/diff or full discovery.
195-205 IM ;; Records manifests validated by the file-change hook.
207-244 IM ;; Field parsing, git invocation and state persistence helpers.

@@ output/template/.claude/hooks/stop-co-change.mjs ;; Executable Stop hook: co-change reminders from the Git working tree, shown once per distinct state via decision:block.
@scope executable Stop hook (end of each Claude turn) in a Git working tree
1-11 IM ;; Header documenting the three reminders, once-per-state behaviour, stop_hook_active loop guard, worktree-aware root.
12-15 IM ;; Registration and manual-test documentation.
17-25 IM ;; Imports, state-file name and skipped directories.
27-28 IM ;; Loop guard: no output while stop_hook_active is true.
30-47 IM ;; Resolves root and Git state; when impossible, emits a 'Co-change check skipped' system message (non-blocking).
49-52 IM ;; Collects changed paths (porcelain status incl. untracked); exits when nothing changed.
54-63 IM ;; Path classifiers: backend tests, migrations, seeder, model (Domain, Persistence/Configurations, *DbContext.cs), backend production, frontend tests/production.
65-69 OL [sc.seeder-reminder]
70-72 OL [sc.migration-review]
73-73 OL [sc.test-gap] ;; ;; const backendGap = changed.some(isBackendProduction) && !changed.some(isBackendTest);
74-74 EX [x.sc-frontend-test-gap] ;; ;; const frontendGap = changed.some(isFrontendProduction) && !changed.some(isFrontendTest);
75-78 MX [sc.test-gap,x.sc-frontend-test-gap] ;; One reminder covers both the backend gap (TST-009/TST-010) and the frontend gap (added).
79 IM ;; Exit when no reminders.
81-101 IM ;; Fingerprint of reminders/paths/content; state stored in Git dir or CLAUDE_HOOK_STATE_DIR so each state reminds once.
103-107 EX [x.sc-address-or-justify]
109-154 IM ;; Git invocation, porcelain parsing, path relativisation and seeder-existence search helpers.

C sc.seeder-reminder OL PST-008 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; At Stop, if Domain/persistence model files changed but no seeder file changed (and a seeder exists), Claude is told to confirm seeded entities are unaffected or update DbSeeder. ;; = ;; Only when a Seeding directory or DbSeeder*.cs exists. ;;
C sc.migration-review OL PST-010 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; At Stop, if EF Core migration files changed, Claude is told to review them before committing. ;; = ;; none ;;
C sc.test-gap OL TST-009,TST-010 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; At Stop, if backend production code changed without any backend test change, Claude is told to confirm regression coverage and that behavioural probes are preserved as tests. ;; = ;; none ;;
C x.sc-frontend-test-gap EX TST-009,TST-010 ENFORCED_ADVISORY ;; At Stop, if frontend production .ts files changed without any .spec.ts/e2e change, the same test-coverage reminder is raised. ;; = ;; none ;; Oracle TST-009/TST-010 are scoped to backend tests; extending the test-change reminder to frontend production code is additional.
C x.sc-address-or-justify EX - ENFORCED ;; The Stop hook returns decision:block once per change-set state; Claude must address each reminder or briefly state why it does not apply before finishing. ;; = ;; Shown once per distinct state; suppressed while stop_hook_active. ;; Imposes a turn-completion gate (address-or-justify each co-change reminder) that the oracle does not require; the oracle policies only require the underlying co-changes/reviews.
